DESCRIPTION: P0 remediation (Codex audit 2026-08-28, C. NOT_READY_FOR_IMPLEMENTATION, 7 P0s) rebuilt this graph smaller and more conservative than v2.0.1. Removed: EXTREME_* strength states, HIGH_CONFIDENCE special-structure routes, CAP-02/03/04 task-capacity verdicts, DISPUTED runtime state, the undefined 'CANDIDATE-ruled-out' pseudo-state, and every count/threshold that materially determined a verdict. Kept only what is fully executable from the frozen fact layer's OWN stated capability (see FACT-03's citation of sameElementRooting.ts's LIMITATIONS array — 'EXISTENCE_FACT_ONLY, NO ... SURVIVABILITY, NO FUNCTIONAL_EFFECTIVENESS' — which independently corroborates the audit's P0-03 finding). v3.1.0 (final single-P0 closure patch, same audit round): removed TRANSFORM-01 and the transformation disjunct from SPECIAL-01 — TRANSFORM-01 declared Day-Master-scoped INPUT_FACTS (AX01_fact/AX02_fact) but its REQUIRED_INFERENCES actually needed result-element-scoped values (transparentRootForResultElement, resultElementMonthRole) that those facts do not produce, making transformationEvidencePresent nondeterministic. TRANSFORMATION_JUDGMENT_V2 = DEFERRED (see docs/myungri-strength-v2/S3_OPERATIONAL_JUDGMENT_GRAPH.md §Transformation judgment deferred) — a deliberate scope decision, not a missing Fact Foundation defect; no new fact provider was added to close this gap. See docs/myungri-strength-v2/S3_OPERATIONAL_JUDGMENT_GRAPH.md for full rationale per node and docs/myungri-strength-v2/S2_S3_FREEZE_GATE_REPORT.md for the P0 closure accounting.

NODES.QUESTION: What natal facts are available given the birth data actually supplied?
POSITIVE_CONDITIONS: year/month/day pillars all resolve to a valid stem+branch (isValidNatalContext, pillarFacts.ts)
DOES_NOT_IMPLY: hourKnown === false does not imply the chart is unusable (P1-01) — only hour-specific position facts become unavailable; every fact derivable from year/month/day proceeds normally, matching NatalPillarContext's own optional `hour` field and calculateSameElementRooting's graceful 3-branch degrade

NODES.QUESTION: What is the Day Master's stem and element?
POSITIVE_CONDITIONS: dayMaster resolved from frozen engine output

UNCERTAINTY_EXIT.condition: never — always available once FACT-01 passes

NODES.QUESTION: Does the Day Master have ANY same-stem root or same-element hidden peer, at ANY available position (existence only — no rank, no strength, no survivability claim)?
POSITIVE_CONDITIONS: ROOT_EXISTS = true if sameElementRoots.length > 0 across all AVAILABLE positions

UNCERTAINTY_EXIT.condition: hourKnown === false AND year/month/day alone show no root (a root could only be confirmed or excluded by the hour branch) -> AX01_fact = ROOT_EXISTS_UNKNOWN, not silently FALSE
UNCERTAINTY_EXIT.note: does not block the graph; SYNTH-01 routes ROOT_EXISTS_UNKNOWN to UNRESOLVED only if the classification would materially depend on it (P1-01)

DOES_NOT_IMPLY: ROOT_EXISTS_TRUE/FALSE is EXISTENCE ONLY — per the frozen service's own LIMITATIONS array ('EXISTENCE_FACT_ONLY_NO_ROOT_STRENGTH_NO_ROOT_RANK_NO_SURVIVABILITY_NO_FUNCTIONAL_EFFECTIVENESS', 'DOES_NOT_APPLY_ANY_CLASH_OR_COMBINATION_OUTCOME'). This graph never claims a root 'survives' or 'is destroyed' by a relation (P0-03/§11/§12 — removed from v2.0.1)

NODES.QUESTION: What is the Day Master's raw month-command role (a descriptive enum, not a score)?
POSITIVE_CONDITIONS: seasonal phase resolves to a role from the frozen engine output

UNCERTAINTY_EXIT.condition: birth within a solar-term boundary the frozen engine itself reports as ambiguous

DOES_NOT_IMPLY: AX02_fact alone does not imply STRONG_LEANING or WEAK_LEANING — season is descriptive only; the verdict is produced solely at SYNTH-01 by combining it with AX01_fact (§13 — removed the 'seasonal override' inference this graph used to compute independently in v2.0.1)

NODES.QUESTION: What 합충형파해 relations exist among the natal pillars (existence only), and does any of them touch a position already counted in AX01_fact, or involve a stated transformation-combination glyph?

OUTPUT.shape: { relations: RelationFact[], touchesRootPosition: boolean, transformationGlyphPresent: boolean }

UNCERTAINTY_EXIT.note: 시지-participant relations simply absent from the list, not blocking

DOES_NOT_IMPLY: RELATION_EXISTS does NOT imply any functional effect (destroyed root, activated support, etc.) — no general relation-precedence or relation-effect rule exists in this graph (P0-03/§14/§15, removed from v2.0.1). touchesRootPosition is carried as a CONTEXTUAL ANNOTATION only; it never changes AX01_fact's value and never independently changes SYNTH-01's classification. transformationGlyphPresent is carried to UNC-FINAL as non-decision descriptive metadata ONLY (NEW-P0-01 remediation, v3.1.0) — no node in this graph consumes it for any decision anymore; TRANSFORM-01, which used to promote it toward a CANDIDATE verdict, was removed because its inference required result-element-scoped facts (transparent root / month role FOR THE TRANSFORMED ELEMENT) that this graph's declared inputs do not produce — see TRANSFORMATION_JUDGMENT_V2 = DEFERRED

NODES.QUESTION: How many distinct positions carry each 십신 family (allied vs opposing the Day Master) — descriptive count, never a verdict input?
POSITIVE_CONDITIONS: distinct-position counts computed, deduplicated across stem/branch/hidden

OUTPUT.shape: { supportCount: number, drainCount: number, incompleteCount: boolean }

UNCERTAINTY_EXIT.condition: never blocks — a partial count with incompleteCount=true is still reported

DOES_NOT_IMPLY: HARD CONTRACT (P0-05/§4): AX09_fact NEVER drives SPECIAL-01, SYNTH-01, or SV-01. It is carried to the final report as descriptive evidence only — no node in this graph reads supportCount/drainCount to decide anything. This is a structural guarantee, not a style note: no edge in NEXT_NODES from FACT-06 leads anywhere but the terminal report

NODES.QUESTION: Is there CANDIDATE-tier evidence of a non-ordinary (following/dominant) structure, using only fully executable facts?
REQUIRED_INFERENCES: CANDIDATE if (AX02_fact === 'OPPOSED' AND AX01_fact === 'ROOT_EXISTS_FALSE'); NONE_DETECTED if the disjunct does not hold; INSUFFICIENT if the CANDIDATE test cannot be completed because a needed fact is ROOT_EXISTS_UNKNOWN. No HIGH_CONFIDENCE route exists in this graph version (P0-01/§7) — see DOES_NOT_IMPLY. No transformation-based disjunct exists in this graph version (NEW-P0-01, v3.1.0) — see DOES_NOT_IMPLY for why TRANSFORM-01 was removed
POSITIVE_CONDITIONS: see REQUIRED_INFERENCES — a named lookup over two boolean-or-enum facts, with no count-based decision rule anywhere in it
COUNTEREVIDENCE: DTS-SHUAIWANG-04/06/08/09/10/12/13/14 (extreme SEASON+no-root by the SHUAIWANG chapter's own 太/極 vocabulary, yet tagged ORDINARY_STRENGTH not SPECIAL_PATTERN — CANDIDATE is the correct, non-committal output for these too under this graph, and that is fine: CANDIDATE never asserts a following pattern, it only flags evidence worth a human/future-module look. See S3_CASE_REPLAY_REPORT.md for the full accounting of which cases land at CANDIDATE without contradiction

DTS-CONGXIANG-01/DTS-CONGXIANG-04/DTS-TIYONG-02: each has a real root at some position (未/戌/寅 respectively), so this rule correctly does NOT grant CANDIDATE via the following-branch disjunct even though the source calls each 從 — this graph does not claim a verdict for these charts beyond NONE_DETECTED; a human reader must supply the compound root+outlet judgment this V2 does not attempt, per P0-01's instruction to accept CANDIDATE/INSUFFICIENT over false certainty

UNCERTAINTY_EXIT.condition: AX01_fact === 'ROOT_EXISTS_UNKNOWN' AND AX02_fact === 'OPPOSED' (the CANDIDATE test cannot be completed)
UNCERTAINTY_EXIT.note: routes to INSUFFICIENT for THIS axis only; does not block SYNTH-01, which has its own independent UNRESOLVED path for the same missing fact

DOES_NOT_IMPLY: CANDIDATE does NOT gate, block, or modify SYNTH-01/SV-01's strength-view computation (P0-02 — the undefined 'CANDIDATE-ruled-out' pseudo-state from v2.0.1 is deleted; there is nothing to rule out, because CANDIDATE never blocked anything to begin with in this version). specialStructureStatus and strengthClassification are reported as two SEPARATE fields in the final output, never merged, never one implying the other — this is how 'strength != special structure' is preserved without needing a gate node. HIGH_CONFIDENCE and DISPUTED do not exist as reachable outputs of this node in v3.0.0 (P0-01/P0-06 — see S2_S3_FREEZE_GATE_REPORT.md for why: every candidate positive-predicate set found during remediation had at least one real corpus counterexample under close scrutiny, so none qualified as 'fully executable' per §7's own standard)

A transformation-based disjunct does NOT exist in this version and its removal does not imply the special screen is broken (NEW-P0-01, v3.1.0): the removed TRANSFORM-01 node declared Day-Master-scoped inputs (AX01_fact/AX02_fact) but its own required inference actually needed a root/season reading for the RESULT element of a stem combination, a differently-scoped pair of values its declared inputs never produced — making its output nondeterministic given only its stated dependencies. TRANSFORMATION_JUDGMENT_V2 = DEFERRED (a scope decision, not a Fact Foundation gap) rather than rebuilt narrower, per instruction not to add a replacement rule this batch

NODES.QUESTION: Combining root existence and seasonal role (the only two facts with agreed executable semantics), what is this chart's structural leaning?
REQUIRED_INFERENCES: ROOT_EXISTS_TRUE + AX02_fact in {DRAINED, OPPOSED} -> MIXED_STRUCTURE (root leans one way, season leans the other; no canonical executable rule in this graph resolves the conflict — P0-03/§17)
ROOT_EXISTS_FALSE + AX02_fact in {IN_COMMAND, SUPPORTED} -> MIXED_STRUCTURE (same conflict, opposite combination)
AX02_fact === 'NEUTRAL' -> follow AX01_fact alone (ROOT_EXISTS_TRUE -> ANCHORED, ROOT_EXISTS_FALSE -> UNANCHORED) since season contributes no lean to disagree with
AX01_fact === 'ROOT_EXISTS_UNKNOWN' -> UNRESOLVED (the classification materially depends on a fact the missing hour pillar could not confirm — P1-01)
POSITIVE_CONDITIONS: see REQUIRED_INFERENCES — a named 2-input lookup table over enum values, never a count, never a weighted sum
COUNTEREVIDENCE: DTS-JINGSHEN-01 / DTS-BAGE-04: harmonious/中和-described charts where the captured source reasoning is more nuanced than a root+season lookup can express — this graph routes them to whichever cell the lookup actually produces, NOT force-fit to a bespoke BALANCED state; P1-05/§31 explicitly forbids inventing a case-specific exception here

UNCERTAINTY_EXIT.note: produces UNRESOLVED as a normal enum output, not a hard block — the case is still reported, just honestly as unresolved (§27)

DOES_NOT_IMPLY: MIXED_STRUCTURE != UNRESOLVED (contradiction != missing data — kept structurally distinct); AX03_fact.touchesRootPosition is included in the evidence output as an ANNOTATION (Option B, §16 — relation treated as contextual evidence, not consumed as a lookup dimension, because no executable general relation-EFFECT rule exists — P0-03/§14/§15) but never changes which lookup cell is selected

NODES.QUESTION: What is the final strength-view classification?
REQUIRED_INFERENCES: ANCHORED -> STRONG_LEANING; UNANCHORED -> WEAK_LEANING; MIXED_STRUCTURE -> MIXED_EVIDENCE; UNRESOLVED -> UNRESOLVED (a direct 1:1 mapping — kept as a separate node from SYNTH-01 to preserve the architectural seam for a future module that might modulate this further, not because the mapping itself is non-trivial)

UNCERTAINTY_EXIT.condition: n/a — always produces a defined output given SYNTH-01 ran

DOES_NOT_IMPLY: EXTREME_WEAK_LEANING_CANDIDATE and EXTREME_STRONG_LEANING_CANDIDATE do NOT exist in this graph version (P0-05/§3 — removed; the prior 'all three axes one-sided with zero counterevidence' rule was an AND-vote in disguise). NOT_APPLICABLE_SPECIAL_STRUCTURE does NOT exist in this graph version either, because nothing produces a HIGH_CONFIDENCE special-structure verdict to gate against (P0-01/P0-02) — specialStructureStatus is reported alongside strengthClassification as an independent field instead

BALANCED does NOT exist as a distinct state in this graph version (§5) — no executable rule currently distinguishes genuine harmonious/中和 structure from MIXED_EVIDENCE's contradictory-evidence state; adding it would require exactly the kind of invented predicate this remediation forbids
taskCapacities is NOT computed by this graph (P0-04/§18 — moved to FUTURE_DOMAIN_JUDGES, out of Strength V2 scope entirely)

NODES.QUESTION: A required fact could not be resolved even from the available pillars — what is reported?
INPUT_FACTS: whichever node routed here, plus its stated UNCERTAINTY_EXIT.condition
DOES_NOT_IMPLY: reaching this node does not imply the chart is unusual — the dominant route here is a genuinely ambiguous solar-term boundary, not a missing hour (P1-01 means a missing hour alone routes to UNRESOLVED at SYNTH-01, not to this hard exit, unless the specific fact needed truly cannot be determined from year/month/day)

NODES.QUESTION: Aggregate every upstream node's output into the final report, with a deterministic confidence class.
REQUIRED_INFERENCES: confidenceClass = 'HIGH' when strengthClassification in {STRONG_LEANING, WEAK_LEANING} AND touchesRootPosition === false (no missing fact, no relation-context caveat)

confidenceClass = 'MODERATE' when strengthClassification in {STRONG_LEANING, WEAK_LEANING} AND touchesRootPosition === true (result supported, but a non-decisive contextual relation caveat is recorded)
confidenceClass = 'LOW' when strengthClassification in {MIXED_EVIDENCE, UNRESOLVED} — implied by the state itself, no separate computation needed (§29)
POSITIVE_CONDITIONS: see REQUIRED_INFERENCES — a named lookup, no numeric confidence score anywhere (§29)

OUTPUT.shape: { strengthClassification, specialStructureStatus, confidenceClass: 'HIGH'|'MODERATE'|'LOW', evidence: JudgmentEvidence[], numerousnessEvidence: AX09_fact, taskCapacities: 'NOT_EVALUATED' }

UNCERTAINTY_EXIT.condition: n/a — the always-reached terminal node for every non-blocked path

DOES_NOT_IMPLY: taskCapacities = 'NOT_EVALUATED' does not imply the architecture is abandoned — the field is reserved for FUTURE_DOMAIN_JUDGES to populate (P0-04/§18/§20), never a fake SUPPORTED/NOT_SUPPORTED
